metric_scope.memory: persistent worker process-lifetime high-water mark, reported separately per protocol run
metric_scope.cpu: Rust worker CPU delta includes decode/algorithm and output PNG encode for write operations
metric_scope.ssim: RGB8 Gaussian11 sigma1.5 valid image interior; geometric attacks use the known geometric reference transform
metric_scope.ber: v1 independent 256-bit observation with explicit synchronization scope; v2 records its known-payload coded-bit scope separately
metric_scope.screenshot: screen_resample is a screenshot-style resampling simulation; source screenshot stratum contains real software screenshots
